package smb

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/metastore"
)

func gateEstablishWatcher(t *testing.T, m *notificationManager, key string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := m.watch(ctx, key, notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096)
		result <- err
	}()
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { m.mu.Lock(); defer m.mu.Unlock(); w := m.watchers[key]; return w != nil && w.ready })
	cancel()
	if err := <-result; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("establish watch: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestGateNotifyRescanRetainsGapEvents(t *testing.T) {
	stream := testNotifyStream()
	source := testNotifySource(stream)
	var tail atomic.Int64
	var checkpoints atomic.Int64
	source.Checkpoint = func(context.Context) (metastore.LogBarrier, error) {
		checkpoints.Add(1)
		return metastore.LogBarrier{Incarnation: "history", Position: metastore.Position(tail.Load())}, nil
	}
	limits := DefaultLimits()
	limits.MaxNotifyEvents = 1
	manager, err := newNotificationManager(t.Context(), source, limits)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer manager.Close()
	gateEstablishWatcher(t, manager, "open")
	establishedCheckpoints := checkpoints.Load()
	stream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Created, "overflow-a", 0)
	stream.changes <- namedChange(2, metastore.Created, "overflow-b", 0)
	tail.Store(2)
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { manager.mu.Lock(); defer manager.mu.Unlock(); return manager.position == 2 })
	if _, err := manager.watch(t.Context(), "open", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096); !errors.Is(err, ErrNotifyRescan) {
		t.Fatalf("overflow: %v", err)
	}
	stream.changes <- namedChange(3, metastore.Created, "created-during-rearm", 0)
	tail.Store(3)
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { manager.mu.Lock(); defer manager.mu.Unlock(); return manager.position == 3 })
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 200*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	events, err := manager.watch(ctx, "open", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096)
	if err != nil || len(events) != 1 || events[0].Name != "created-during-rearm" {
		t.Fatalf("rescan lost the rearm gap: events=%v error=%v", events, err)
	}
	if checkpoints.Load() != establishedCheckpoints {
		t.Fatalf("established watch was rebaselined %d times", checkpoints.Load())
	}
}

func TestGateNotifyRescanRejectsReplacedSource(t *testing.T) {
	oldStream, newStream := testNotifyStream(), testNotifyStream()
	var subscriptions atomic.Int64
	source := testNotifySource(oldStream)
	source.Subscribe = func(context.Context) (ChangeStream, error) {
		if subscriptions.Add(1) == 1 {
			return oldStream, nil
		}
		return newStream, nil
	}
	manager, err := newNotificationManager(t.Context(), source, DefaultLimits())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer manager.Close()
	gateEstablishWatcher(t, manager, "old-open")
	oldStream.failures <- syscall.ESTALE
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { manager.mu.Lock(); defer manager.mu.Unlock(); return manager.failure != nil })
	if err := manager.Health(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if subscriptions.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("source was not replaced: %d", subscriptions.Load())
	}
	if _, err := manager.watch(t.Context(), "old-open", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096); !errors.Is(err, ErrNotifyRescan) {
		t.Fatalf("old-source notification: %v", err)
	}
	manager.mu.Lock()
	ready := manager.watchers["old-open"].ready
	manager.mu.Unlock()
	if ready {
		t.Fatal("a replaced source preserved the old watch registration")
	}
	gateEstablishWatcher(t, manager, "old-open")
	newStream.changes <- namedChange(1, metastore.Created, "new-source", 0)
	waitNotify(t, func() bool { manager.mu.Lock(); defer manager.mu.Unlock(); return manager.position == 1 })
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	events, err := manager.watch(ctx, "old-open", notificationIdentity{ID: 1, Directory: true}, 1, true, 4096)
	if err != nil || len(events) != 1 || events[0].Name != "new-source" {
		t.Fatalf("new-source watch: %v %v", events, err)
	}
}
